Payment Retry Policy

This page describes how payment retries are scheduled and executed. Related work is tracked in PAY-981.

Payment Retry Policy > Retry schedule

Retries use exponential backoff starting at 30 seconds, doubling up to a maximum of 1 hour. After 12 failed attempts the payment is parked and an alert fires.

The schedule is owned by the retry-scheduler service.

Payment Retry Policy > Idempotency

Every retry carries the original idempotency key. Downstream processors MUST treat a repeated key as a no-op and return the original result.

heading_path: Payment Retry Policy > Idempotency > Key format
text:
Payment Retry Policy > Idempotency > Key format

Keys are UUIDv7, generated at payment creation, never regenerated on retry.

Payment Retry Policy > Alerting

Parked payments raise a PagerDuty alert to the payments on-call. Runbook steps live in [[payments/parked-payments-runbook]].
